help.title: Docs — Serpmonn partner network
help.lead: Short guides for advertisers and publishers: offers, links, conversions, and moderation.
help.adv.body:
Advertisers place offers and pay for confirmed conversions. Publishers take offers and put links on their sites.

  1. Registration as Advertiser and sign-in to the cabinet.
  2. Balance top-up in the Money tab (request or payment).
  3. Offer creation: promo or CPA, landing, terms, rate, and hold (0–180 days).
  4. For Russia — an ERID (ORD marking token).
  5. Submission for moderation. After publish the offer appears for publishers.
  6. Conversion reporting setup (see below) — otherwise only clicks remain in stats.

Each conversion charges the publisher rate plus the network fee (usually 10%). Publisher hold is set per offer.
help.pub.body:
Publishers take published offers and place a tracked link. Payout is for conversions confirmed by the advertiser.

  1. Registration as Publisher — a site code is issued.
  2. In the catalog, copy a link like /go/…?p=code. The hold column shows how many days until payout unlocks.
  3. The link is placed on a site or in mailings. Clicks without ?p= are ignored.
  4. Stats and available balance are in the cabinet.
  5. Withdrawal is requested from the cabinet; payout is confirmed by the network.
help.track.body:
Click. The publisher places a link like /go/…?p=code. The user follows it: the click is recorded and the browser is redirected to the advertiser landing with click_id in the URL. That id must be stored (cookie, CRM, or a hidden form field).

Conversion. When the client buys or leaves a lead, the advertiser site or CRM calls the postback once with the stored click_id and amount.

The template is in the advertiser cabinet under Conversion reporting. Example:

/api/partners/postback?click_id=…&amount=500&status=confirmed

For reject or chargeback: status=rejected with the same click_id.

Without postback only clicks remain in reports. No custom API is required — a normal HTTP request is enough.
help.mod.body:
New and edited offers are reviewed by the network before publish.

  • Landing, terms, rate, and (for RU) ERID are checked.
  • Statuses in the cabinet: in moderation, published, rejected, draft.
  • On rejection the reason is shown in the offer list; after fixes the offer is resubmitted.
  • Unpublishing moves the offer to draft — publishers no longer see it.

help.intro.body:
The Serpmonn partner network connects companies and audience-owned properties in a single placement model.

  • Advertiser publishes an offer: the proposition, terms, and reward for a completed action.
  • Publisher promotes the offer via a partner link on their property and is paid for confirmed results.

Payouts are for conversions — when a user follows the link and completes the target action under the offer terms (lead, purchase, etc.).

Publishers need a property or channel with an audience: registration, offer selection, link placement, then stats and payouts in the cabinet.

Below are instructions for cabinets, tracking, and moderation.

help.title: Docs — Serpmonn-partnernetværk
help.linkTitle: Korte docs til annoncører og publishers

adv.body:
Annoncører placerer tilbud og betaler for bekræftede konverteringer. Publishers tager tilbud og sætter links på deres sites.

  1. Registrering som Annoncør og login til panelet.
  2. Saldoopfyldning under fanen Penge (anmodning eller betaling).
  3. Oprettelse af tilbud: promo eller CPA, landing, vilkår, sats og hold (0–180 dage).
  4. For Rusland — en ERID (ORD-markeringstoken).
  5. Indsendelse til moderation. Efter publicering vises tilbuddet for publishers.
  6. Opsætning af konverteringsrapportering (se nedenfor) — ellers forbliver kun klik i statistikken.

Hver konvertering trækker publisher-satsen plus netværksgebyr (normalt 10 %). Publisher-hold sættes pr. tilbud.

pub.body:
Publishers tager publicerede tilbud og placerer et sporingslink. Udbetaling er for konverteringer bekræftet af annoncøren.

  1. Registrering som Publisher — der udstedes en sitekode.
  2. I kataloget kopieres et link som /go/…?p=code. Hold-kolonnen viser, hvor mange dage der er til udbetaling frigives.
  3. Linket placeres på et site eller i mailings. Klik uden ?p= ignoreres.
  4. Statistik og tilgængelig saldo findes i panelet.
  5. Udbetaling anmodes fra panelet; betaling bekræftes af netværket.

track.body:
Klik. Publisheren placerer et link som /go/…?p=code. Brugeren følger det: klikket registreres, og browseren omdirigeres til annoncørens landing med click_id i URL’en. Dette id skal gemmes (cookie, CRM eller skjult formularfelt).

Konvertering. Når kunden køber eller efterlader et lead, kalder annoncørens site eller CRM postback én gang med den gemte click_id og beløbet.

Skabelonen findes i annoncørpanelet under Konverteringsrapportering. Eksempel:

/api/partners/postback?click_id=…&amount=500&status=confirmed

Ved afvisning eller chargeback: status=rejected med samme click_id.

Uden postback forbliver kun klik i rapporterne. Ingen egen API kræves — en almindelig HTTP-forespørgsel er nok.

mod.body:
Nye og redigerede tilbud gennemgås af netværket før publicering.

  • Landing, vilkår, sats og (for RU) ERID tjekkes.
  • Status i panelet: under moderation, publiceret, afvist, kladde.
  • Ved afvisning vises årsagen på tilbudslisten; efter rettelser indsendes tilbuddet igen.
  • Afpublicering flytter tilbuddet til kladde — publishers ser det ikke længere.

intro.body:
Serpmonn-partnernetværket forbinder virksomheder og flader med publikum i én placeringsmodel.

  • Annoncør publicerer et tilbud: proposition, vilkår og belønning for en gennemført handling.
  • Publisher promoverer tilbuddet via et partnerlink på sin flade og betales for bekræftede resultater.

Udbetalinger er for konverteringer — når en bruger følger linket og fuldfører målhandlingen under tilbudsvilkårene (lead, køb osv.).

Publishers har brug for en flade eller kanal med publikum: registrering, valg af tilbud, linkplacering, derefter statistik og udbetalinger i panelet.

Nedenfor: vejledning til paneler, sporing og moderation.
